original_ai_prompt: We recently split our network into two VLANs — one side has six PCs and the other five — and now half the machines can't get an address; they just self-assign and can't reach anything, not even our intranet server. It sits on the first VLAN and also does DNS for us. Redesign it so both VLANs hand out proper addresses and everything that should reach the server can. We're on DSL.
